items.title: OpenAI bets on families as ChatGPT goes deeper into households
items.summary: ChatGPT is hiring a dedicated product manager to build experiences for families, caregivers, and older adults, according to a job posting.
items.titleZh: 随着ChatGPT深入家庭，OpenAI押注家庭
items.summaryZh: 根据招聘信息，ChatGPT正在招聘一名专门的产品经理，为家庭、护理人员和老年人打造体验。

items.title: While Musk's Neuralink drills into skulls, China's BrainCo bets the future of brain tech is wearable
items.summary: Interest in brain-computer interfaces is rising as it promises to help people with compromised neural abilities.
items.titleZh: 当马斯克的Neuralink钻入头骨时，中国BrainCo押注大脑技术的未来是可穿戴的
items.summaryZh: 人们对脑机接口的兴趣正在上升，因为它有望帮助神经能力受损的人。

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway gains ground, but still trails the S&P 500 as '26 enters second half
items.summary: With 2026 a bit more than half over, Berkshire Hathaway's B shares are down 1.8% year-to-date and 12.4 percentage points behind the S&P 500's 10.7% gain.
items.titleZh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦公司股价上涨，但仍落后于标准普尔500指数，因为'26进入下半年
items.summaryZh: 2026年已经过去了一半多一点，伯克希尔哈撒韦公司的B股今年迄今下跌了1.8%，落后于标准普尔500指数10.7%的涨幅12.4个百分点。

items.title: Elon Musk Reacts To Apple's Trade Secrets Lawsuit On OpenAI: ‘Scam Altman Strikes Again’
items.summary: Not his first. Elon Musk reacted to Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI over breach of trade secrets with his trademark jibe at CEO Sam Altman. Once pals and co-founders of OpenAI, Musk and Altman are at odds now more than ever.
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克回应苹果对OpenAI的商业机密诉讼：“骗局Altman再次出击”
items.summaryZh: 不是他的第一次。埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）对苹果公司就OpenAI侵犯商业机密提起的诉讼做出了回应，他对首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼（Sam Altman）进行了商标嘲讽。马斯克和奥特曼曾经是OpenAI的朋友和联合创始人，现在比以往任何时候都更加不和。

items.title: Why the 2026 IPO boom is about to broaden beyond AI mega-deals
items.summary: After SpaceX’s record IPO, investors are starting to eye new sectors.
items.titleZh: 为什么2026年的IPO热潮即将超越人工智能大型交易
items.summaryZh: 在SpaceX创纪录的IPO之后，投资者开始关注新的行业。

items.title: Kids, rowdy riders, don't forget: Waymo could be watching
items.summary: Waymo used in-cabin cameras to report two teens who were later detained by the San Mateo Police Department, authorities said.
items.titleZh: 孩子们，吵闹的骑手，别忘了：Waymo可能在看
items.summaryZh: 当局表示，Waymo使用机舱内摄像头报告了两名青少年，他们后来被圣马特奥警察局拘留。

items.title: Apple is suing OpenAI, alleging former employees stole trade secrets to build AI hardware
items.summary: Apple has sued OpenAI for allegedly stealing its trade secrets to develop an AI-focused device and other hardware. Apple alleges that as over 400 former employees left to join the ChatGPT maker, many of them routinely accessed Apple's confidential data relate…
items.titleZh: 苹果正在起诉OpenAI，指控前雇员窃取商业机密以构建人工智能硬件
items.summaryZh: 苹果公司起诉OpenAI涉嫌窃取其商业机密，以开发一款专注于人工智能的设备和其他硬件。苹果公司声称，随着400多名前员工离职加入ChatGPT制造商，他们中的许多人经常访问苹果公司的机密数据…
